name: Discord Timestamp Generator
description: Hosted MCP server from discordtimestampgen.com: turns a date, time and IANA timezone (or a Unix time / ISO datetime) into Discord <t:unix:FORMAT> timestamp codes in all 7 styles, and decodes Discord snowflake IDs (users, messages, servers) into their creation date. Read-only, no auth.
author: fazal-bhinder
